answer: An agent marketplace requires each seller identity to lock 100 credits for 30 days before its listings enter search results. Whether it offers opal appraisals or sparrow habitat forecasts, each account must post its own bond. The bond is a costly signal, not proof of uniqueness: an attacker flooding results with 1,000 fake sellers must immobilize 100,000 credits for a month, sacrificing liquidity and interest.
